sample_unit: ED patients with chest pain or palpitations (ECGs)

links.outcome: Agreement with cardiologist consensus for ECG interpretation: AI models versus emergency specialists
links.effect: Emergency specialists showed kappa 0.689-0.874 versus cardiologists; ChatGPT kappa 0.386 and Gemini kappa 0.224, i.e., AI lower than clinicians.
links.quote: Both showed lower agreement with cardiologists than emergency specialists.

links.outcome: AI clinical performance for MACE risk stratification and ECG interpretation versus cardiologist reference
links.effect: ChatGPT 96.3% sensitivity, 85.4% accuracy; Gemini 92.6% sensitivity, 79.8% accuracy for 30-day MACE; low ECG agreement (kappa 0.386, 0.224); findings do not support rule-out use.
links.quote: These preliminary findings do not support rule-out use and, at most, suggest a supplementary decision-support role, requiring further multi-center validation.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial multimodal LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) for ECG interpretation and MACE risk stratification compared to human clinicians on prospective clinical ECG data, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
